notes: «عن أبيه» after جعفر بن محمد بن عمارة is a bare relation; «أبيه محمد بن علي» and the others are one link each by the name alone (rule 7); the Imams named after «عن» stay narrators; «قال أمير المؤمنين» names the speaker only in the words after the chain, so he is the last link (owner ruling 2)
